name: dynamic storage survives repeated awaits and exceptions
source: async function main(): Promise<void> { const values: {x: number}[] = []; const exposed: any = values; const original: any = new Function("return {x: 1}")(); exposed[0] = original; const fail: any = new Function("value", "throw value"); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { await Promise.resolve(); try { fail(original); } catch (error) { } original.x += 1; } console.log(values[0] === original, exposed[0] === original, values[0].x); }
